name: coutreach-touch-opens
description: Prospect marketing, build plan § 7e.9 (ruling 96; Doug's ruling at the M9 plan, 10-27-26): the Constant Contact send report records opens on the touch beside clicks. COutreachTouch gains openCount (how many times the recipient opened the email) and firstOpenedAt (the first open). Additive only; nothing Read-only (ruling 40: the application writes both under the org-wide API key). The Marketing Admin Role reads touches already. Handoff: coutreach-touch-opens-crm-handoff.md.

fields.name: openCount
fields.label: Opens
fields.tooltipText: How many times the recipient opened the email, as Constant Contact reports it. Some mail programs open every message automatically, so this runs high.

fields.name: firstOpenedAt
fields.label: First opened
fields.tooltipText: When the recipient first opened the email, as Constant Contact reports it.
